Ham Quiche
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 12:02am

Ingredients




2 cups Cheddar or Colby cheese, shredded
1 cup Cooked ham, cubed
1/4 cup Green pepper, chopped
1/4 cup Pimiento, chopped
2 cups Half and half
1/4 teaspoon Salt
1/2 teaspoon Nutmeg, oregano, or fen
5 Eggs, beaten
1 10-inch prepared pastry shell

Preparation

1 Beat eggs; add half and half. Add remainder ingredients and pour into pastry shell. Bake at 350 degress F. for 40 to 45 minutes or until knife inserted just off center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes before serving.
